notes: Captions, GIF, still-frame, your own logo and batch upscaling are now reachable in the app — they were in the engine and on the site, but no control started them. The Export panel picks the format (H.264, HEVC, AV1, ProRes) and container. Ask Crisp for several things at once and it does all of them. Big media bins keep their thumbnails, and a file that vanishes mid-render says so instead of blaming your codec.
